title: HEIC2PNG
subtitle: Image Format Converter
description: Turns iPhone HEIC photos into PNG from the CLI, a shell pipe or Python. A small tool for a small, recurring annoyance.
longDescription: Convert iPhone HEIC photos to PNG or JPEG through Python, a CLI or shell pipes. A Pillow / pillow-heif implementation handles transparency, with explicit quality controls for PNG palette reduction and JPEG output.
features: CLI, Python API and shell-pipe input/output
